text:
I only have the "before" photo of a glass of milk, so I'm assuming the original tray held more than that. The "after" tray shows an empty cup, two empty glasses, an empty yogurt cup, a plate with food residue and a lemon wedge, and an empty butter pat and jam pack. I can't see what the plate originally held, so I'm guessing at it.

The glass looks like about 250 ml of milk, which is roughly 258 g and about 160 kcal if it is whole milk. One of the two glasses probably held milk and the other water. The yogurt cup looks like a 170 g tub at about 100 kcal. The plate shows yellow and green smears, which could be egg or a similar dish, so I'm assuming about 200 kcal and 150 g was eaten. The butter and jam packs add roughly 50 kcal and 20 g. The coffee cup and sugar stick add about 20 kcal and 5 g.

Adding these up gives about 160 + 100 + 200 + 50 + 20 = 530 kcal. The mass is about 258 + 170 + 150 + 20 + 5 = 603 g.

{"kcal": 530, "mass_g": 600}
